title.narrative: Integrated Multisectoral Lifesaving response to IDPs and Host Communities in East Belessa woreda of Amhara region, Ethiopia.

description.narrative: ltpgtInternational Medical Corps UK*ltbrgtInternational Medical Corps (IMC) is a US-registered independent affiliate organization of International Medical Corps UK (IMC UK), with which IMC UK shares the same name and charitable objectives and mission. IMC UK and IMC work together to deliver assistance programs in an accountable and effective manner in pursuit of their commonly held charitable objectives. IMC UK will engage IMC to implement its programmes in the field, with IMC UK oversight, according to the terms and conditions of the agreement that results from this proposal and the terms of the parties’ administrative service agreement. Together with IMC Croatia, IMC provides administrative and operational support to IMC UK and to the programmes on the ground, including but not limited to financial management, banking and cash management, procurement management/international procurements and logistics.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThis project targets east Belesa woreda of central Gonder Zone, Amhara Region. The objective of the project is to provide dignified, Rights-based integrated multi-sectoral humanitarian assistance to displacement and conflict-affected populations to meet immediate lifesaving needs, provide safe and inclusive access to essential services, and contribute to a well-coordinated response that ensures gender, protection, accountability to affected people (AAP), and (PSEA) are well integrated. The Project shall focus on Health, Nutrition, Protection, and WASH support.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtltspangtThe health part has a total of 15,754 beneficiaries and does provision of Primary health care , Maternal and child health, strengthening routine and emergency immunization, support and strengthen surveillance activities, capacity building of government health care providers, Risk communication and Community engagement, support the full functionality of health facilities through provision of Pharmaceutical supplies, medicines and equipment, repair and furnish of some health facilities, integrated MHPSS services, and integrated MISP for SRH services including family planning counseling and service provision, ANC, PNC, syndromic treatment of STIs and CMR/IPV. This will be accomplished by deploying one MHT and One Surge team at the targeted woreda health facilities. The Protection component will be mainstreaming and will focus on assisting IDPs with entitlement to HLPs and legal assistance, reducing the vulnerability of IDPs to risk and human rights violations. lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe nutrition program will prioritize the Nutrition specific (treatment of acute malnutrition) and Nutrition sensitive (IYCF, SBC, FSL, hygiene promotion and MPC) integrated with health targeted to most vulnerable beneficiaries. The nutrition activities shall involve all the stakeholders from the program design up to the end of the project life through project cycle management. The proposed nutrition program is planned to reach 155,332 conflict and drought affected communities’ children 0-59 months and PLW as well as health staff and community volunteers. The major planned activity includes capacity building, system strengthening to respond to acute malnutrition and drought in the targeted woreda through CMAM integrated with IYCF and Hygiene promotion. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe WASH results are addressed in four components each with detailed activities that are pertinent to contribute to each output Improve access to water supply and sanitation facilities, improve solid waste, and complement with Hygiene promotion along with addressing the basic priority need of WASH NFIs and Dignity kits through multipurpose cash-based approaches to enable the affected community to exercise hygienic practices, supporting towards positive behavioral changes and reduce the potential risk of WASH-related disease transmission is fundamental to a successful WASH response.lt/pgt
